name: norm
expr: n_v2 = norm(v); n_v1 = norm(v, 1); n_vinf = norm(v, Inf); n_vninf = norm(v, -Inf); n_vninf3 = norm([-7 2 5], -Inf); n_a2 = norm(A); n_a1 = norm(A, 1); n_ainf = norm(A, Inf); n_afro = norm(A, 'fro');
comment: Sig: n = norm(X[, p]). Vector and matrix norms. Vector: 2-norm default, p-norm via sum(|x|^p)^(1/p), Inf -> max(|x|), -Inf -> min(|x|) (fixed 2026-06-03; was max), 1 -> sum(|x|). Matrix: 2-norm = largest singular, 1 -> max col sum, Inf -> max row sum, 'fro' -> Frobenius (-Inf invalid for matrices). Bit-identical with MATLAB R2025b.
